descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S09 「选择器里超过 40 个病人：第 46 个还能找到，并拿到文字」 Picker with more than 40 patients: the 46th is still reachable and gets the text

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given 45 Hospital patients in rooms 1–45 plus QA Hosp Zuniga in room 999 (last in room order)

When Type 'Seen and examined, stable, continue current plan.' into a box, open Assign to patient without searching, then search 'Zuniga' and pick him; open both charts

Then Zuniga is found through the search and his Encounter note ends with the box text; QA Hosp Bulk 001's note does not have it

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp2 mustContain '999 · QA Hosp Zuniga'; cp3 mustContain '999 · QA Hosp Zuniga', 'Re-assign'; cp4 Zuniga's Encounter mustContain the text; cp5 Bulk 001's Encounter mustNotContain it (U2). cp1 (no search) is recorded for Q9: whether Zuniga is listed at all

在哪跑：dev 单元 U05；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
